report.decision_text: Stop — not feasible as currently described
report.summary: The startup analyzed the feasibility of creating an AI service to predict lottery numbers with 99% accuracy. The analysis found that the market, financials, technical implementation, operational aspects, and competition were all weak, making the venture infeasible. Therefore, the founders decided to stop the project.

sections.title: Feasibility by dimension
items: Market: Weak — The evidence suggests that predicting lottery numbers with 99% accuracy is not feasible due to the nature of legitimate lotteries.
Financial: Weak — The market for AI lottery prediction tools is likely small and saturated, with high competition and low profit margins.
Technical: Weak — The evidence indicates that AI cannot predict lottery numbers, making the technical implementation of such a venture infeasible.
Operational: Weak — The operational aspects of running a lottery prediction service are complex and regulated, making it difficult to execute.
Competitive: Weak — The evidence suggests that there are already established AI-powered lottery prediction tools, making it difficult to compete.
